page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, meaning hyperthreading is disabled to ensure predictable, dedicated compute performance. The processor operates at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz.

The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core. This memory density positions the server in the memory-optimized category. It does not include local NVMe SSD storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high memory capacity offer a robust resource density for enterprise workloads. The lack of hyperthreading ensures that each of the 48 vCPUs maps directly to a physical core, eliminating resource contention. This makes the instance highly suitable for memory-intensive applications, relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and enterprise workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without virtualization overhead.
